9095514359

Bangalore, India

Summary

Technical Business Analyst with 6+ years of experience in banking and digital transformation, specializing in requirement analysis, API integrations, and Agile delivery. Proven ability to drive data-driven decision-making, optimize business processes, and support end-to-end system implementations. Expanding expertise in AI/ML, LLMs, and cloud-based data solutions to enable intelligent automation.

Work Experience

Technical Business Analyst/Scrum Master, iGreenData - A Synechron Company Led Agile delivery of banking regulatory and digital initiatives, improving sprint

predictability and ensuring timely releases aligned with business goals. Collaborated with engineering teams using Python and SQL to validate end-to-end data flows

05/2025 – Present

Reduced requirement rework by 30% by defining clear API contracts, refining user

stories, and aligning stakeholders on acceptance criteria.

Optimized loan onboarding and processing workflows by identifying process gaps

and leveraging data insights, reducing operational issues by 20%.

Owned end-to-end requirement lifecycle from discovery to deployment,

translating business needs into functional and technical specifications (BRD/FRD).

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to support API integrations, data

mapping, UAT, and production releases, ensuring seamless system communication.

Improved data traceability by documenting end-to-end data lineage across APIs, Kafka events, and downstream banking systems, enabling faster impact analysis, regulatory compliance, and efficient root cause investigation.

12/2016-12/2024 IT Business Analyst, TATA Consultancy Services Limited Led process optimization initiatives in banking operations, reducing operational costs by 20% through workflow improvements and data-driven analysis and Leveraged Python and SQL to analyze the data

Supported implementation and enhancement of Loan Origination and Loan Management Systems (LOS/LMS) by gathering requirements, documenting workflows, and collaborating with business and IT teams across the commercial lending lifecycle.

Worked with data pipeline concepts using Azure Data Factory to support data

integration and reporting workflows.

Facilitated system integrations, data mapping, and testing activities by creating process/system flows, coordinating UAT, and supporting migration from legacy banking systems.

Implemented a customer feedback analytics framework to identify service gaps in

digital banking channels, contributing to a 15% improvement in customer satisfaction scores.

Education

B.E Computer Science, Rajalakshmi Institute of Technology/Chennai 6.295GPA

06/2011 – 04/2014

Key Skills

Technical & Integration SQL (MySQL), API Integration (REST, SOAP, Swagger, Postman), Data Mapping, Python, Data lineage

Cloud & Emerging Azure Data Factory (Basic), AI/ML Concepts, LLM & RAG (Awareness)

Agile & Tools Jira, Confluence, Agile/Scrum, User Stories, UAT

Core Competencies Requirement Gathering, Stakeholder Management, Process Optimization, Analytical Thinking

PROJECTS(BANKING,E-COMMERCE)

Investor Portfolio Management System Developed an Investor Portfolio Management solution to provide investors and portfolio managers with

real-time visibility into portfolio performance, asset allocation, and investment returns.

Improved investment decision-making by enabling portfolio performance analysis, risk monitoring, and KPI-

based reporting through interactive dashboards.

Collaborated with stakeholders to gather business requirements, define portfolio performance metrics,

validate data quality, and support UAT for investment reporting solutions.

Loan Approval Prediction System Developed a loan approval prediction solution to support faster and more accurate lending decisions

through business and data analysis.

Reduced loan processing turnaround time by leveraging SQL and Python for customer data analysis,

validation, and reporting.

Improved approval accuracy by defining business rules, validating datasets, and identifying customer

eligibility trends for stakeholders.

AI-Driven Loan Risk Prediction & Intelligent Decisioning (ML/LLM Concepts) Defined business requirements for an AI-based loan risk prediction solution by identifying key variables such

as credit score, income, and repayment history to support eligibility assessment.

Collaborated with stakeholders and data teams for data mapping and validation, ensuring alignment

between predictive outputs and business rules for faster, data-driven loan approvals.

Languages

Tamil Native or Bilingual Proficiency

English Native or Bilingual Proficiency

Kannada Limited Working Proficiency
